name: spotcool-dashboard
description: The judges' dashboard for the SpotCool world: one screen for a simulated office building's run.

scripts.gen:types: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('src/contracts', { recursive: true, force: true })" && uv run python ../../packages/contracts/scripts/export_schemas.py src/contracts/schemas && json2ts -i src/contracts/schemas -o src/contracts/types
scripts.build: npm run gen:types && tsc -b && vite build
